decision.explanation: The question asks for the founding date of 'the Elks organization'. The sources describe multiple distinct entities sharing the 'Elks' name, each with a specific founding date supported by the text: 1) The Benevolent and Protective Order of Elks (USA) was founded in 1868 (D3S5). 2) The Improved Benevolent and Protective Order of Elks of the World (IBPOEW) was established in 1897 (D4S2). 3) The Elks of Canada was founded in 1912 (D1S1). 4) The Denver Lodge (a local chapter) was founded in 1895 (D2S3). 5) An entity referred to as 'EMBA' (likely a specific association or chapter within the broader Elks context mentioned in D5) was founded in 1878 (D5S1). 6) The BPOE is described generally as having its inception in the 'late 1800's' (D6S2). The date 'September 11, 1914' refers to the founding of the 'Royal Purple', which is explicitly identified as a women's auxiliary (D7S4), not the main Elks organization itself, so it is excluded. All other dates correspond to distinct valid referents or complementary descriptions of the organization's history found in the source text.
